results.label: scam
results.text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an unpaid customs fee of $1.99. Pay within 12 hours or it will be returned: http://usps-redelivery-help.top/pay
results.summary: This fake USPS text tries to send you to a lookalike site (usps-redelivery-help.top, not usps.com) to pay a $1.99 fee — USPS never requests customs or redelivery payments by text.

results.label: scam
results.text: FedEx: We attempted delivery but nobody was home. Confirm your address and reschedule here: fedex-reschedule-now.info/track?id=88213
results.summary: This is a fake FedEx delivery message using a lookalike website that is not FedEx's real site — do not click or enter your address.

results.label: scam
results.text: DHL Express: your parcel is held at our depot. A customs charge of $2.45 is required. Pay at dhl-customs-pay.xyz to release it.
results.summary: This is a fake DHL customs-fee scam using a lookalike website (dhl-customs-pay.xyz) that is not DHL's official dhl.com and doesn't even exist in official records.

results.label: scam
results.text: NJ E-ZPass: You have an unpaid toll balance of $12.50. To avoid a $50 late fee, pay by today: ezpass-nj-tollpay.top/inv
results.summary: This text impersonates NJ E-ZPass and pushes you to pay a fake toll via a lookalike .top website that does not exist on the official E-ZPass system.

results.label: scam
results.text: Chase Alert: Unusual $849.00 charge on your card. If this was not you, verify now or your account will be locked: chase-secure-verify.top/login
results.summary: This is a fake Chase alert sending you to chase-secure-verify.top, which is not Chase's real website (chase.com) and uses threats to get you to click.

results.label: scam
results.text: Wells Fargo: Your account has been temporarily restricted. Call our fraud department at 1-855-555-0113 immediately to restore access.
results.summary: This is a fake Wells Fargo alert trying to get you to call a scammer-run 1-855 number — Wells Fargo doesn't send "account restricted, call this number immediately" texts like this.

results.label: scam
results.text: Bank of America: we detected a login from a new device. To cancel, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent you.
results.summary: This is a scam impersonating Bank of America to steal your one-time login code and take over your account.

results.label: scam
results.text: Zelle: A payment of $500 to you is pending because your account is not upgraded. Send $100 to unlock it, you will be refunded instantly.
results.summary: This is a fake Zelle message — real Zelle never asks you to send money to unlock a payment, and the promise of an instant refund is a trick to steal your $100.

results.label: scam
results.text: Venmo: you were sent $350 by mistake. Please return it via this link right away or your account will be suspended: venmo-refund-help.click/r
results.summary: This is a fake Venmo refund message — the link uses an imitation address (venmo-refund-help.click) that isn't Venmo's real site venmo.com and threatens suspension to pressure you to click.

results.label: scam
results.text: PayPal invoice #INV-44821 for $479.99 (Norton antivirus renewal) has been paid. If you did not authorize this, call 1-888-555-0177 within 24 hours to cancel.
results.summary: This is a fake PayPal/Norton invoice callback scam that tries to get you to call a scammer phone number to “cancel” a bogus charge.

results.label: scam
results.text: Amazon: Your order of an iPhone 15 Pro for $1,149 has been placed. If you did not make this purchase call 1-877-555-0166 to cancel.
results.summary: This is a fake Amazon order alert that wants you to call 1-877-555-0166; Amazon does not cancel orders by having you call a number in a text.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, this is Mark from the Amazon billing team. Your account has a security hold. To clear it purchase two $500 Amazon gift cards and read me the codes.
results.summary: This impersonates Amazon's billing team and asks you to pay with gift cards to clear a security hold, which Amazon never does.

results.label: scam
results.text: IRS FINAL NOTICE: You owe $2,847 in back taxes. A warrant will be issued for your arrest today. Call 855-555-0142 immediately and pay with Apple gift cards. Do not tell anyone.
results.summary: This is a fake IRS arrest threat trying to get you to pay with Apple gift cards, which the real IRS never does.

results.label: scam
results.text: This is the Social Security Administration. Your social security number has been suspended due to suspicious activity. Call 855-555-0150 or a warrant will be issued for your arrest.
results.summary: This is a fake Social Security arrest-threat scam — the real SSA never suspends SSNs or threatens arrest by phone/text.

results.label: scam
results.text: Medicare: you are eligible for a new 2026 benefits card with $1,200 in grocery allowance. Reply YES and confirm your Medicare number to receive it.
results.summary: This is a Medicare impersonation scam trying to steal your Medicare number with a fake $1,200 grocery allowance card offer.

results.label: scam
results.text: Apple ID: Your iCloud account is locked due to suspicious activity. Verify within 24h or all photos will be deleted: apple-id-unlock.support/verify
results.summary: This is a fake Apple iCloud alert trying to scare you into clicking a lookalike link that is not on Apple's real domains.

results.label: scam
results.text: WARNING: Your computer is infected with 5 viruses! Do not turn off your PC. Call Microsoft Support now at 1-800-555-0123.
results.summary: This is a fake Microsoft virus pop-up scam trying to get you to call a scammer phone number.

results.label: scam
results.text: Geek Squad: your 3-year protection plan renews today for $389.99. To cancel and get a refund call 1-866-555-0188.
results.summary: This is a fake Geek Squad renewal invoice telling you to call to cancel — a well-known scam impersonating Best Buy.

results.label: scam
results.text: Netflix: your payment failed and your account will be closed. Update billing now: netflix-billing-update.top/account
results.summary: This is a fake Netflix impersonation trying to steal your payment details — the link is not Netflix.com and uses a lookalike domain with a threat to close your account.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi Sarah, are we still on for dinner Friday? Let me know!
results.summary: This is a classic wrong-number opener greeting you as 'Sarah' to get you to reply.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hello, I got your number from a friend. I'm Emily, I just moved to the city and don't know anyone. Can we chat? 😊
results.summary: This is an unsolicited friendly message from a stranger claiming to be Emily who wants to chat, which is the typical opening step for wrong-number and romance scams.

results.label: scam
results.text: I've been making $3,000 a week with a crypto trading platform my uncle taught me. I can show you how, small deposit of $250 to start, guaranteed returns. Message me on WhatsApp.
results.summary: This is a fake crypto investment scam promising impossible guaranteed $3,000 a week from a $250 deposit and trying to move you to WhatsApp.

results.label: scam
results.text: My dear, I am a US Army engineer deployed overseas. I have fallen in love with you. I need $800 in iTunes cards to take leave and come meet you.
results.summary: Message pretends to be a deployed US Army engineer declaring love and demanding $800 in iTunes gift cards to pay for leave — a classic romance/military impersonation scam.

results.label: scam
results.text: Grandma it's me, I'm in jail and I need bail money, please don't tell mom and dad. Can you send $2,400 in Google Play cards? A lawyer will call you.
results.summary: This is the classic grandparent bail scam — a fake family emergency asking for secrecy and payment in Google Play gift cards, which police and real lawyers never use.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi! We found your resume. Remote job, earn $200-$400 per day liking videos. No experience needed. Contact our manager on Telegram @workfromhome_jobs to start today.
results.summary: This is a fake job offer — real employers do not pay $200-$400 a day just to like videos and do not recruit by telling you to message a random Telegram account.

results.label: scam
results.text: Congratulations on the personal assistant job! Enclosed is a check for $3,800. Deposit it and send $1,500 via Zelle to our equipment vendor, keep the rest as your pay.
results.summary: This is a classic fake-check scam: the check will bounce and any money you send via Zelle is lost and cannot be recovered.

results.label: scam
results.text: CONGRATULATIONS! You've won $750,000 in the Mega Millions International Lottery. To claim, send a $199 processing fee. Reply with your full name and bank details.
results.summary: This is a lottery scam — you never need to pay a fee or give bank details to claim a real lottery prize.

results.label: scam
results.text: Coinbase: a withdrawal of 0.8 BTC is pending. If this was not you, secure your wallet immediately by entering your 12-word recovery phrase: coinbase-secure-wallet.info
results.summary: This is a fake Coinbase alert trying to steal your crypto by asking for your 12-word recovery phrase on coinbase-secure-wallet.info, which is not Coinbase.

results.label: scam
results.text: You are eligible for a tax refund of $1,462.18. Submit your request and bank details here to receive the payment: gov-taxrefund-claim.top
results.summary: This is a fake tax-refund scam impersonating the government to steal your bank details — the link is not the official IRS website and does not resolve.

results.label: scam
results.text: Duke Energy: your power will be disconnected in 1 hour due to an overdue balance of $312. Pay now using a Bitcoin ATM, call 1-800-555-0102 for instructions.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, are you at your desk? I need you to buy 5 Target gift cards for a client gift, $200 each. I'm in a meeting so can't talk. I'll reimburse you today. Send me the codes. - Jim, CEO
results.summary: This is a classic CEO gift-card scam impersonating your boss to get you to buy gift cards and send the codes.

results.label: scam

results.summary: Text claims to be State DMV demanding $58 via dmv-state-pay.xyz or face license suspension — this is a common smishing scam, not a real government domain.

results.label: scam
results.text: You qualify for federal student loan forgiveness of up to $20,000. This offer ends tonight. Reply with your FSA ID and SSN to apply.
results.summary: Message impersonates federal student loan forgiveness and asks you to reply with your FSA ID and SSN — legitimate agencies never ask for those by text and this creates identity theft risk.
